text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHS11, 6" Brass Pineapple Door Knocker

The 6 Inch Brass Palm Springs Pineapple Door Knocker features amazing detail that make it so much more than a front door knocker, its a statement that shows off your personal taste. The 6 inch Brass Pineapple Door Knocker is easy to install and surface mounts to your wood or metal door with the included hardware.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Also Available larger 8-1/2" Brass Pineapple Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Pineapple Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Polished and Highlighted Brass
  • Height: 6"
  • Width: 2-13/16" at widest part
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 3-3/4"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Available in 3 finishes:
Brass Nickel Silver Oiled Bronze

Sold Individually
